purpose: Reads and writes AppConfig to/from config.json, normalizing values and returning safe defaults on any failure.
calls_out_to: TargetFilePolicy.NormalizePath / IsSupportedTarget — clears unsupported AppPath on load
invariants: Load always returns a valid, normalized AppConfig even if the file is missing or corrupt
Save writes atomically via a .tmp sidecar + File.Move to avoid partial writes
gotchas: NormalizeInPlace silently clears AppPath if the extension is not in TargetFilePolicy.SupportedExtensions — hand-editing the config to add an unsupported type will lose the value on next load
Normalization runs on both Load and Save, so out-of-range values passed to Save are silently corrected
